sentences.en: Even after sunset there was little moderation in the temperature.
sentences.zh: 即使到了日落后气温也没有明显下降。

sentences.en: Beer is not really so unhealthy, at least in moderation.
sentences.zh: 啤酒其实并不那么不健康，至少适量饮用的话。

sentences.en: It's all right to drink, but drink in moderation.
sentences.zh: 可以喝酒，但一定要适量。

senses.zh: 适度,自我节制,稳定，镇定,（牛津大学）B.A学位的第一次考试
